component.name: ScratchClip
component.summary: Lightweight clipboard history manager for Linux

description.p: ScratchClip is a lightweight, modern, and feature-rich Linux desktop clipboard history manager built with Avalonia UI and .NET 10. It runs quietly in the system tray, keeps track of your recently copied content, and lets you quickly search, reuse, edit, and manage previous clipboard entries.
ScratchClip supports text, images, links, code, files, and folders, with automatic content recognition and specialized previews for different types of clipboard data.

ul.li: Clipboard Monitoring - Automatically captures text, images, files, and folders in near real time
Persistent History - Saves clipboard history to an encrypted file for access across application sessions
Smart Type Recognition - Automatically identifies links, programming languages, XML, JSON, Markdown, and other content types
Filtering & Search - Filter history by content type or quickly find entries using fuzzy search
Edit & Delete - Edit or remove clipboard entries directly from the application
Quick Selection - Press 1–200 to instantly select a visible clipboard entry
Link & YouTube Previews - Automatically recognizes copied URLs and provides rich metadata previews
Image Support - Automatically stores and displays copied images in clipboard history
File & Folder Support - Copy, paste, and manage files and folders from clipboard history
Smart Tagging - Automatically analyzes and tags clipboard content
System Theme Adaptation - Automatically follows system Light/Dark theme
Global Hotkey - Show or hide ScratchClip from anywhere
Encrypted Storage - Clipboard history is encrypted with AES-256-GCM
Password Protection - Optional password protection for clipboard history
OS Keyring Integration - Secure storage of encryption secrets
